environment: macOS, live Electron 41 development build, isolated -fleet1542 profile; real PTYs, seeded agent/review/help state
checks: Default agent Jump closes Fleet and focuses the target
Opt-in same-pane Jump retains search/filter and routes actual keyboard input to Alpha
Cross-workspace Jump routes actual input only to Beta while Fleet stays open
Escape in the terminal does not dismiss Fleet
Keyboard Enter Jump keeps Fleet open and transfers focus
Closing after kept-open jumps never restores the original pane
Preference survives close/reopen within the session
Cmd+Shift+A (macOS Fleet shortcut) opens and closes Fleet with keep-open enabled
Row-menu Jump keeps Fleet open and hands focus to the destination
Review-task keyboard Jump keeps Fleet open and focuses its real PTY (seeded review record)
Open diff closes Fleet even when keep-open is on (navigation only; seeded task)
Browser-help Jump closes Fleet and selects its browser surface (seeded help request)
Unique fresh rapid keyboard input survives live status reordering without changing pane labels (both real PTYs)
Full Electron process restart with the same isolated profile resets keep-open to off
notes: Agent navigation used real daemon-backed PTYs with controlled echo processes; no model inference was invoked.
Review and browser-help records were seeded UI fixtures. Open diff was checked for navigation/overlay dismissal, not task-backend diff correctness.
macOS shortcut is Cmd+Shift+A; Ctrl+Shift+A remains the Windows/Linux mapping.
App restart was a full Electron process stop/start with the same isolated profile.
